meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声并部署到谷歌量子硬件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用谷歌量子硬件做低层电路开发或量子表征实验
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise, and deploy to Google quantum hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing low-level quantum circuits for Google hardware or running characterization experiments

howto.what: Claude 可以用 Cirq 库来设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模，并能连接 Google、IonQ、Azure Quantum 等量子硬件。
howto.when: 当你需要构建或模拟量子电路、在 Google 量子硬件上运行实验、或进行噪声建模与表征时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Cirq 创建一个包含 Hadamard 和 CNOT 的贝尔态电路。
say.note: Claude 会生成并模拟该电路，输出测量结果。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对参数化电路进行参数扫描，theta 从 0 到 2π。
say.note: Claude 会生成扫描代码并运行模拟。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the Cirq library to design, simulate, and run quantum circuits, supporting parameter sweeps, noise modeling, and connection to quantum hardware from Google, IonQ, Azure Quantum, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build or simulate quantum circuits, run experiments on Google quantum hardware, or perform noise modeling and characterization.

say_en.text: Create a Bell state circuit with Hadamard and CNOT using Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and simulate the circuit, outputting measurement results.

say_en.text: Sweep theta from 0 to 2π for a parameterized circuit in Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will generate sweep code and run the simulation.
